scenicChapters.title: Montenegro Durmitor Ring
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 1907 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Montenegro Durmitor Ring
scenicChapters.narrative: For 29 km this is Montenegro Durmitor Ring, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

montenegro-durmitor-ring.story: 65 km round from Žabljak - plan on about 1 h 03 of riding. On the way it passes Sedlo Pass, Trsa and Tara Canyon. The highest point is about 1,900 m. Sedlo Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
